description: Approved plan: reuse channel_ingress_status per connector with generic provider aggregate via IngressStatusUI; reuse ConversationIdentity.normalize at Incoming boundary; explicit SMTP/IMAP new/edit modes using existing forms and ChannelConnectorCard, insert instead of provider upsert, preserve defaults and reply bindings. Add regression/property tests, run mix q and isolated suites. Existing domain implementations extended, no new Action or automatic tool exposure. Feature E2E approval remains separate.

comments.text: Implemented approved generic fixes. Index requests explicit connector IDs; API resolves that config; IngressStatusUI aggregates and modal lists each connector. Incoming normalizes room/thread/message IDs through existing ConversationIdentity; shared bridge accepts signed external IDs. Real Telegram private/group/topic regression uncovered chat-local message ID collisions and capture/admission mismatch: Channels now stamps typed source_scope (Telegram chat ID), Engine consumes it generically for capture and admission locks/lookups. Same numeric message ID across three chats captures once each; admission reuses captured UUID and replays do not re-admit. SMTP/IMAP Add Config uses explicit new selection, named form, distinct insert and selects saved ID; tests preserve original rows and edit second row. Runtime integer-message-ID expectation deliberately updated to canonical string while asserting original transport remains integer. mix q PASS; 558 tests/2 properties PASS; diff check clean. Required existing full Playwright E2E attempted via npm run test -- --reporter=line, exceeded 900s; available traces report localhost:4002 server connectivity/beforeEach navigation failures. No complete E2E pass; issue remains open for browser validation. No new feature E2E authored, no migrations or commit/push.

History rows now reuse ChannelIcons for both thread/root rows; email/IMAP/SMTP aliases share existing email logo in ChannelIcons. Existing BO history tests pass with final regression set. E2E availability and outcome validation remain open.

Fixed CI regressions: email bridge tests now preserve missing application env keys instead of restoring explicit nil; history ingress explicitly scopes/restores Zaq.Agent.Pipeline; integer upsert test expects canonical string output while preserving integer adapter input. Focused email/history/Jido suites pass; mix q passes; initial mix precommit had unrelated LLMPerformanceFailureTest failure which passed isolated, repeat mix precommit passes.
